query: SELECT name, sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE type IN ('table','view') ORDER BY name
result: Eight base tables tab01-tab08 with foreign keys: tab01(account) references tab05(district); tab02(card) references tab04(disposition); tab03(client) references tab05; tab04(disposition) references tab01 and tab03; tab06(loan), tab07(order), tab08(transaction) reference tab01. No views, no age column, no account-number text column.

query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tab01; ... tab08
SELECT COUNT(*), COUNT(DISTINCT fld009) FROM tab03; SELECT COUNT(*), COUNT(DISTINCT fld001) FROM tab01; SELECT COUNT(*), COUNT(DISTINCT fld006) FROM tab04
result: tab03 5,369/5,369; tab01 4,500/4,500; tab04 5,369/5,369. All three identifier columns are unique keys in their own tables.

query: SELECT fld010, COUNT(*) FROM tab03 GROUP BY fld010 ORDER BY fld010
result: F 2,645; M 2,724. No other values. Of clients born before 1950-01-01: F 1,084 and M 1,162.

query: SELECT MIN(fld011), MAX(fld011) FROM tab03; SELECT MIN(fld011) FROM tab03 WHERE fld010='F'
result: Birth dates range from 1911-08-20 to 1987-09-27. The minimum female birth date is 1914-03-01 and exactly one female client has it.

query: SELECT substr(fld004,1,4) AS y, COUNT(*) FROM tab01 GROUP BY y ORDER BY y
SELECT fld003, COUNT(*) FROM tab01 GROUP BY fld003
result: POPLATEK MESICNE 4,167; POPLATEK TYDNE 240; POPLATEK PO OBRATU 93.

query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT fld002) FROM tab01; SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tab01 a LEFT JOIN tab05 d ON a.fld002=d.fld002 WHERE d.fld002 IS NULL
result: 77 distinct branch district identifiers; 0 accounts without a matching district row.

query: SELECT fld007, COUNT(*) FROM tab04 GROUP BY fld007; SELECT fld001, SUM(CASE WHEN fld007='OWNER' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) c FROM tab04 GROUP BY fld001
result: OWNER 4,500 and DISPONENT 869. Every account has exactly one OWNER record; 0 accounts have more than one OWNER. 4,500 accounts and 5,369 holder records.

query: SELECT COUNT(*), COUNT(DISTINCT fld005), COUNT(DISTINCT fld006) FROM tab02; SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tab02 ca LEFT JOIN tab04 d ON ca.fld006=d.fld006 WHERE d.fld006 IS NULL
result: 892 cards, 892 distinct card ids, 892 distinct holder records; one card per holder record; 0 orphan cards.

query: SELECT fld007, COUNT(*) FROM tab02 GROUP BY fld007; SELECT d.fld007, COUNT(*) FROM tab02 ca JOIN tab04 d ON ca.fld006=d.fld006 WHERE ca.fld007='gold' GROUP BY d.fld007
result: classic 659; gold 88; junior 145. All 88 gold cards are attached to OWNER holder records.

query: SELECT COUNT(*), COUNT(DISTINCT fld027), COUNT(DISTINCT fld001) FROM tab06; SELECT fld001 FROM tab06 GROUP BY fld001 HAVING COUNT(*)>1
result: 682 loans, 682 distinct loan ids, 682 distinct accounts; no account has more than one loan.

query: SELECT fld031, COUNT(*) FROM tab06 GROUP BY fld031 ORDER BY fld031
SELECT MIN(fld028), MAX(fld028) FROM tab06
result: Loan amount range 4,980 to 590,820; no NULLs.

query: SELECT MIN(fld004), MAX(fld004) FROM tab06
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tab08

query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tab06 l LEFT JOIN tab01 a ON l.fld001=a.fld001 WHERE a.fld001 IS NULL; same for tab08 and tab02
result: 0 loans, 0 transactions and 0 cards without their parent account or holder record. All 5,369 clients have a district value that exists in tab05.

query: SELECT name, sql FROM sqlite_master; SELECT MAX(fld004) FROM tab08; SELECT MAX(fld004) FROM tab06
result: No age column exists in any table. Latest transaction date 1998-12-31; latest loan date 1998-12-08. Age can only be derived from tab03.fld011 with an assumed reference date.

query: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN c.fld002=a.fld002 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), SUM(CASE WHEN c.fld002<>a.fld002 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM tab04 d JOIN tab03 c ON d.fld009=c.fld009 JOIN tab01 a ON d.fld001=a.fld001
result: 4,875 holder records have client residence district equal to the account branch district; 494 have a different value. The two attributes are therefore not interchangeable.
